# External Subprojects & Upstream References

This directory contains key reference implementations, environments, and experiments bundled directly into the PokémonRL repository to ensure 100% reproducible out-of-the-box execution for all users without requiring external submodules.

| Directory | Upstream Repository | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `PokemonRedExperiments/` | [PWhiddy/PokemonRedExperiments](https://github.com/PWhiddy/PokemonRedExperiments.git) | Original baseline RL environment + `jippity-6-test` Cerulean City autonomous pipeline |
| `pokemonred_puffer/` | [drubinstein/pokemonred_puffer](https://github.com/drubinstein/pokemonred_puffer.git) | High-throughput PufferLib vectorization wrapper |
| `pokered/` | [pret/pokered](https://github.com/pret/pokered.git) | Full assembly disassembly of Pokémon Red/Blue |
| `PokeRL/` | [reddheeraj/PokemonRL](https://github.com/reddheeraj/PokemonRL.git) | Alternative Gym environment implementation |
| `metamon/` | [UT-Austin-RPL/metamon](https://github.com/UT-Austin-RPL/metamon.git) | Meta-learning benchmark for Pokémon |
| `continual-harness/` | [sethkarten/continual-harness](https://github.com/sethkarten/continual-harness.git) | Continual learning benchmark harness |
